title: WEEK (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT {fn WEEK('2004-02-25')} AS Wk_Date, {fn WEEK('2004-02-25 08:35:22')} AS Wk_Tstamp, {fn WEEK(59590)} AS Wk_DInt
SELECT {fn WEEK('2000-01-01')}||{fn DAYNAME('2000-01-01')} AS WeekofDay1, {fn WEEK('2000-01-02')}||{fn DAYNAME('2000-01-02')} AS WeekofDay2
SELECT {fn WEEK({fn NOW()})} AS Wk_Now, {fn WEEK(CURRENT_DATE)} AS Wk_CurrD, {fn WEEK(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)} AS Wk_CurrTS, {fn WEEK($HOROLOG)} AS Wk_Horolog, {fn WEEK($ZTIMESTAMP)} AS Wk_ZTS
